questions.question: What does HTML stand for?
questions.explanation: HTML stands for Hyper Text Markup Language — the standard language for creating web pages.

questions.question: Which tag defines the document type?
questions.explanation: <!DOCTYPE> declares the document type and version of HTML being used.

questions.question: Which HTML tag represents the largest heading?
questions.explanation: <h1> is the highest-level heading, representing the main topic of the page.
